I can't confirm Donjuan Triumphant's 2020 stud fee from memory, and I have no source that favours either €7,500 or €12,000. The team note's rationale ("reports of his debut season") doesn't establish a figure, so I won't pick one as fact. The Weatherbys or Equineline stud book listing for the 2020 season would settle it.
